headline: Jamie Dimon launches cross-industry AI risk alliance
body: A quiet day with one story. JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon is expanding the Alliance for Critical Infrastructure into a 40-plus organisation effort with the US government to anticipate AI risks. That gives Alignment & Control a small boost, lifting Protector God and easing Conquerors. Horizon Balance improved to +0.01.
movers_note: Conquerors -0.1, from the Dimon alliance (-0.10) and fading earlier news (-0.04). Zookeeper -0.1, from the Dimon alliance (-0.07) and fading earlier news (-0.04).
